messages:
anya: dropped a compact prototype for a tiny menu inside the performance badge: Catalog / Pinned / Details. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-proto
tom: high-level Q: when a version is pinned, do badges default to pinned metrics or catalog metrics? which is less surprising?
rachel: my vote: pinned-by-default if the user took the explicit action. otherwise they lose context. but we need a clear affordance to switch back.
eli_a11y: a11y checklist: visible focus, aria-label like 'P95 latency for Model Y (pinned v1.4)  98 milliseconds', and make dynamic updates announce via aria-live polite. contrast: current amber fails 4.5:1 at 12px.
sam_frontend: impl note: per-row menus hurt list virtualization. prefer a session-level override stored in route state and a contextual hint on the row that opens the toggle. avoids per-row DOM state.
jorge: telemetry: ~17% of catalog sessions have a pinned version; only ~4% toggle metric view in compare. cohort small but meaningful.	
anya: proposal: default to catalog metrics. when a single row is pinned, show an inline hint "Pinned active 12 show pinned metrics". if user accepts, persist for session. multi-select pin opens dense compare modal that always shows pinned metrics per-row.
build-bot: ci: visual-scan for branch badge-menu-toggle -> https://ci.internal/snap/9981 (diffs: focus ring and badge color)
tom: microcopy: keep visual short 'p95:98ms' but provide verbose aria-label for screenreaders. also keep any tooltip <100 chars.
eli_a11y: +1 to aria-label + aria-live. ensure toggle control uses role=menuitemcheckbox or a proper menu pattern.
sam_frontend: dev estimate: 1.5 days to wire route state + portal popover, then a11y review.
anya: cool. if product/design/eng/a11y OK i'll move to PR. thumbs? :eyes:
tom: :+1:
eli_a11y: :+1: with notes above
rachel: :+1: thanks, i'll update figma and paste a short checklist here."
